scenarios.why: A question about a move's reason asks for the motivation check, not a new move.

scenarios.request: why does the camera push in here
scenarios.why: Asking why the camera pushes is a question to answer, so it must not lay another push-in.

scenarios.request: flag any unmotivated moves in the scene
scenarios.why: Unmotivated moves are what the check reports, shot by shot.

scenarios.request: does the dolly have a reason to move
scenarios.why: The dolly named in a question about its reason is the move to judge, not a dolly to add.

scenarios.request: start the push on the reveal
scenarios.why: The push already exists; it should begin on the reveal beat, so the move is retimed.

scenarios.request: settle the move on the landing
scenarios.why: Coming to rest on the landing is the move's end aligned to a motion beat.

scenarios.request: time the push to her confession
scenarios.why: Timing a push to a line starts it on that story beat.

scenarios.request: end the pan on the decision
scenarios.why: Ending a pan on a beat aligns its rest, not its start.
A frame named outright is the beat the crane should start on.
A confession is a disclosure the motion cannot show, so it is marked as a story beat.
The kind named in the words is the beat's kind and its label.

scenarios.request: add a story beat called the gun comes out at 64
scenarios.why: A gun coming out is a threat; the label is the words after called.
Moving a named beat changes its frame, not a camera move.
Removing a beat names it by its label.

scenarios.request: push in slowly on Mara as she confesses
scenarios.why: Asking for a new push-in, even with its reason, lays the move; it is not a check or a retime.
